candidates.title: Enterprise integration
candidates.statement: The system shall be part of an enterprise-level Library Automation System and integrate with enterprise management processes.
candidates.source_quote: Management Processes are part of an enterprise-level Library Automation System.

candidates.title: Use acquisitions and cataloging data
candidates.statement: The system shall rely on the data structures and functionality of an enterprise-level Library Automation System, including Acquisitions and Cataloging modules.
candidates.source_quote: Management Processes rely on the data structures and functionality of an enterprise-level Library Automation System, including Acquisitions and Cataloging modules.

candidates.title: Centralized management services
candidates.statement: The system shall consolidate management processes at a central location and accept input and provide services to multiple locations.
candidates.source_quote: Management Processes are consolidated at a central location, and accept input and provide services to multiple locations.

candidates.title: Vendor interfaces and file transfer
candidates.statement: The system shall interface with vendor websites via published APIs and/or automated transfer of standard-format data files (for example USMARC21 or EDIFACT).
candidates.source_quote: Management Processes interface with a variety of vendor websites, via published APIs and/or automated transfer of standard-format data files (e.g., USMARC21, EDIFACT).

candidates.title: OPAC interaction
candidates.statement: The system shall interact with a patron interface (Online Public Access Catalog, OPAC).
candidates.source_quote: Management Processes interact with a patron interface, also known as an Online Public Access Catalog (OPAC).

candidates.title: Card-swipe staff login
candidates.statement: The system shall allow staff to log into terminals by swiping a card (for example an RFID employee badge).
candidates.source_quote: a staff member could swipe a card (like an RFID employee badge) to log in

candidates.title: Username/password staff login
candidates.statement: The system shall allow staff to log in using individual login credentials (username and password) as a login method.
candidates.source_quote: or alternatively use individual login credentials (username and password).

candidates.title: Card login optional
candidates.statement: The system shall not require card-based login; username/password login must be available as a fallback.
candidates.source_quote: The system should not REQUIRE card-based login - traditional username/password should also be available as a fallback.

candidates.title: Create report templates
candidates.statement: The system shall allow system administrators to create report templates that are available to staff.
candidates.source_quote: System administrators should be able to create report templates that are available to staff.

candidates.title: Runnable or modifiable templates
candidates.statement: The system shall allow report templates to be run as-is or modified for individual needs.
candidates.source_quote: These templates should be runnable as-is or modifiable for individual needs.

candidates.title: Template modification accuracy
candidates.statement: The system shall ensure that changes to report templates do not compromise the accuracy of results.
candidates.source_quote: Changes to templates should not compromise the accuracy of results.

candidates.title: Administrators restrict template edits
candidates.statement: The system shall allow administrators to limit which filters and display fields in a template can be altered to certify dependable output.
candidates.source_quote: Administrators should be able to limit which filters and display fields can be altered, to certify a dependable output.

candidates.title: Prevent display of deleted items via templates
candidates.statement: The system shall allow template restrictions that prevent front-line staff from altering a template to display deleted items.
candidates.source_quote: they should not be able to alter the template to display deleted items.

candidates.title: Fine-grained report permissions
candidates.statement: The system shall provide distinct, fine-grained permission levels that limit who can create and clone reports.
candidates.source_quote: The system should provide distinct, fine-grained permission levels that limit who can create and clone reports.

candidates.title: Permissions ease-of-administration
candidates.statement: The system shall make all report permissions easy to administer.
candidates.source_quote: All permissions should be easy to administer.

candidates.title: Shared folders for report access
candidates.statement: The system shall allow system administrators to create shared folders to allow or disallow staff from running specific reports.
candidates.source_quote: System administrators should be able to create shared folders to allow or disallow staff from running specific reports,

candidates.title: Control ad hoc report running
candidates.statement: The system shall allow administrators to allow or disallow staff from running ad hoc reports on specific sets of data.
candidates.source_quote: and/or to run ad hoc reports on specific sets of data.

candidates.title: User-friendly query designer
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a user-friendly interface for designing queries against all record types: bibliographic, item, patron, transaction, and financial.
candidates.source_quote: The system should provide a user-friendly interface for designing queries against all record types (bibliographic, item, patron, transaction, financial).

candidates.title: Select fields to query
candidates.statement: The system shall allow staff to select which fields to query.
candidates.source_quote: Staff should be able to: - Select fields to query

candidates.title: Picklist values in queries
candidates.statement: The system shall allow staff to select values from a picklist of possible values when designing queries.
candidates.source_quote: - Select values from a picklist of possible values

candidates.title: Regex selection in queries
candidates.statement: The system shall allow staff to select regular expressions from a drop-down menu when designing queries.
candidates.source_quote: - Select regular expressions from a drop-down menu

candidates.title: Boolean operators in queries
candidates.statement: The system shall allow staff to use a full range of Boolean operators in queries.
candidates.source_quote: - Use a full range of Boolean operators

candidates.title: Admin control of table/field access
candidates.statement: The system shall allow administrators to control staff access to database tables and fields used in queries.
candidates.source_quote: Administrators should control staff access to tables and fields.

candidates.title: Pre-defined board/executive reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide pre-defined reports for consumption by library boards and other external consumers, including basic statistics required by the Georgia Annual Report and Application for State Aid.
candidates.source_quote: The system should provide pre-defined reports for consumption by library boards and other external consumers. These should include basic statistics like those required by the Georgia Annual Report and Application for State Aid.

candidates.title: Activity statistics
candidates.statement: The system shall provide activity reports that display statistics on check-outs, check-ins, holds placed, and holds filled.
candidates.source_quote: Activity reports should indicate traffic and volume of use, displaying statistics on check-outs, check-ins, holds placed, and holds filled.

candidates.title: Cross-tabulation of activity
candidates.statement: The system shall support cross-tabulation of activity statistics per terminal, per branch, per library system, per hour, per patron age range, per patron type, and per patron location.
candidates.source_quote: It should be possible to cross-tabulate per terminal, per branch, per library system, per hour, per patron age range, per patron type, and per patron location.

candidates.title: Anonymized transaction archiving
candidates.statement: The system shall archive transaction data in a form that protects patron privacy as defined by State Law while providing useful demographic statistics.
candidates.source_quote: Transactions should be archived in a form that protects patron privacy as defined by State Law, while providing useful demographic statistics.

candidates.title: Periodic report examples support
candidates.statement: The system shall support generation of periodic reports including: bibliographic records with holds; items not checked out in X days; item-level holds; items with invalid item type; in-transit items with outstanding hold; items in-transit more than X days; items that are the last copy; items with a long call number; missing items; bibliographic records with no item records; patrons with invalid home library.
candidates.source_quote: Examples of periodic reports include: - Bibliographic records with holds - Items that have not been checked out in X days - Item-level holds - Items with invalid item type - In-transit items with outstanding hold - Items that have been in-transit for more than X days - Items that are the last copy in the system - Items with a long call number - Missing items - Bibliographic records with no item records - Patrons with invalid home library

candidates.title: Show query criteria with results
candidates.statement: The system shall display the query selections along with the results so users can see what criteria were used to generate the report.
candidates.source_quote: The system should provide the query selections along with the results, so users can see what criteria were used to generate the report.

candidates.title: Report queue visibility
candidates.statement: The system shall allow staff to see where their report is in the queue of reports waiting to run.
candidates.source_quote: Staff should be able to see where their report is in the queue of reports waiting to run.

candidates.title: Support canned report definitions (Appendix A)
candidates.statement: The system shall support the reporting definitions as described in the attached report examples (Appendix A).
candidates.source_quote: The system must be able to support the reporting definitions as described in the attached report examples (see Appendix A).

candidates.title: Support fine-grained reporting spec (Appendix B)
candidates.statement: The system shall support the fine-grained reports requirements as described in the attached specification (Appendix B).
candidates.source_quote: The system must be able to support the fine-grained reports requirements as described in the attached specification (see Appendix B).

candidates.title: Patron behavior statistics
candidates.statement: The system shall produce statistics to understand and predict patron behavior and use of materials, such as average return time, renewal likelihood, and percent check-outs that are renewals at a branch.
candidates.source_quote: The system should produce statistics that can be used to understand and predict patron behavior and use of materials. For example: - How quickly is a particular book returned, on average? - How likely is a particular book to be renewed? - What percent of check-outs at a particular branch are renewals?

candidates.title: Produce anonymized demographic statistics
candidates.statement: The system shall produce demographic statistics (transactions by geographical regions, age ranges, etc.) using anonymized data with identifying information deleted.
candidates.source_quote: The system should produce useful demographic statistics, including transactions by geographical regions, age ranges, etc. The data used to produce these statistics must be anonymized - information that could be used to identify a patron is deleted.

candidates.title: Material volume reporting
candidates.statement: The system shall report on the volume of material in a given library at any point in time based on new acquisitions, items on the shelf, and items out in circulation, and allow breakdowns by categories such as total items, number of holds, adult fiction, board books, etc.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to report on the volume of material in a given library at any point in time, based on new acquisitions, items on the shelf, and items out in circulation. The report should allow breaking down volume in categories such as: total items in library, number of holds, number of adult fiction, number of board books, etc.

candidates.title: Branch capacity interface
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an interface showing the capacity of all branches.
candidates.source_quote: The system should provide an interface showing the capacity of all branches.

candidates.title: Shelf space comparison report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a shelf space report that, for each genre and format, compares percentage of total circulations, percentage of the collection, and percentage of total shelf space, and can run per library and per system.
candidates.source_quote: For each genre and format of material, ability to compare: - The percentage of total circulations - The percentage of the collection - The percentage of total shelf space. The report should be able to run per library and per system.

candidates.title: Manage uncataloged material
candidates.statement: The system shall provide the ability to control inventory of uncataloged material (e.g., paperback and children's board books) supporting quick distribution, minimal branch labor, and the ability to identify how the material is being used.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to control inventory of uncataloged material, such as paperback books and children's board books. Support needed for: - Quick distribution - Minimal branch labor - Ability to identify how the material is being used

candidates.title: Count uncataloged transactions
candidates.statement: The system shall count transactions for uncataloged material and include those counts in circulation statistics and reports.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to count transactions and include in circulation statistics and reports.

candidates.title: Batch item transfer utility
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a utility for transferring batches of items between branches.
candidates.source_quote: System should provide a utility for transferring batches of items between branches.

candidates.title: Query candidate materials for transfer
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to query for candidate materials to include in a transfer batch.
candidates.source_quote: The utility should include: - Ability to query for candidate materials

candidates.title: Save transfer queries
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to save queries for repeated use when selecting items for transfer.
candidates.source_quote: - Ability to save queries for repeated use

candidates.title: Manual selection from query results
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to manually select titles from query results for inclusion in a transfer batch.
candidates.source_quote: - Ability to manually select titles from query results

candidates.title: Change records to new location
candidates.statement: The system shall allow changing records of selected items to move them to a new location as part of a transfer.
candidates.source_quote: - Ability to change records of selected items to move to new location

candidates.title: Transfer mechanisms
candidates.statement: The system shall provide mechanisms for moving items such as changing the location field and generating pull lists.
candidates.source_quote: - Mechanisms for moving items: changing location field, generating pull lists

candidates.title: Revert transferred items
candidates.statement: The system shall provide the ability to revert items to their original location after a set period of time.
candidates.source_quote: - Ability to revert items to original location after a set period of time

candidates.title: Missing and damaged items report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide reports of missing and damaged items per branch.
candidates.source_quote: The system should provide reports of missing and damaged items per branch.

candidates.title: In-transit items overdue report
candidates.statement: The system shall generate a list of items that have been in-transit for more than X days (X configurable), per branch and per system.
candidates.source_quote: The system should generate a list of items that have been in-transit for more than X days (X configurable), per branch and per system.

candidates.title: Merge transit-to and transit-from
candidates.statement: The system shall merge transit-to and transit-from information into a single in-transit report for front-line staff use.
candidates.source_quote: The report should merge the transit-to and transit-from into one report for ease of front-line staff use.

candidates.title: Item purge identification utility
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a utility and reports for identifying item records to purge based on customizable criteria such as items in status 'missing' for more than X months or status 'discard/weed'.
candidates.source_quote: The system should provide a utility and reports for identifying item records to purge, based on customizable criteria such as: - An item has been in status "missing" for more than X months - An item has status "discard/weed"

candidates.title: Report to assist status conversion
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report to assist in the conversion of items from one status to another.
candidates.source_quote: The system should have a report to assist in the conversion of items from one status to another.

candidates.title: Last copy report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a last copy report that singles out a library system's last copies to assist catalogers editing WorldCat entries.
candidates.source_quote: The system should provide a last copy report that singles out a library system's last copies, to assist catalogers who need to edit WorldCat entries.

candidates.title: Bulk delete volume and copy entries
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a quick effective method of deleting volume entries along with copy entries, as well as records with no items attached.
candidates.source_quote: The system should provide a quick effective method of deleting volume entries along with copy entries, as well as records with no items attached.

candidates.title: Track deletions by location and system
candidates.statement: The system shall count and track record deletions (for example item records and patron records) per location and per system.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to count and track record deletions (e.g., item records, patron records) per location and per system.
